mongodbTarget: 8.0+ replica set; verify exact server/driver versions at implementation
notes: PK is _id for every regular collection.
Composite UK means the whole named index key, not each field separately.
FK and conditional business constraints are enforced in application code.
Daily/intraday Finnhub quotes are not persisted to MongoDB in v1.
Payload object subtype contracts and reference checks are specified in the design document.
Every daily scan persists its batch and every attempted instrument outcome; not just Top N. Scan history is distinct from raw historical price bars.
